a: Transformers use attention to model relationships across sequences.
Attention weights how much each token influences another.
Embedding layers map discrete tokens to dense vectors.
Softmax turns scores into a probability distribution.
Batch normalization stabilizes training by normalizing layer inputs.
Schedules change learning rate during training for better convergence.
Early stopping ends training when validation performance stops improving.
Augmentation creates varied training examples from existing data.
Transfer learning reuses a model trained on one task for another.
